```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false
for (pkg in c("patchwork", "scales", "plotly")) {
  if (!requireNamespace(pkg, quietly = TRUE)) renv::install(pkg)
}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(tidyverse)
  library(patchwork)
  library(scales)
  library(plotly)
})

pos_colors <- c(QB = "#E15759", RB = "#59A14F", WR = "#4E79A7", TE = "#B07AA1")

theme_set(theme_minimal(base_size = 13))
theme_update(
  plot.title    = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
  plot.subtitle = element_text(color = "grey45", size = 11),
  legend.position = "top"
)
```

```{r}
#| label: load-data
#| include: false
season <- readRDS("data/sfb16_season_totals.rds")
weekly <- readRDS("data/sfb16_weekly_scores.rds")

season <- season |>
  mutate(across(c(position, team), as.factor))

# Top 20 by season total (skill positions only)
top50 <- season |>
  slice_max(total_sfb16_fpts, n = 50) |>
  mutate(
    player_label  = paste0(player_name, " (", team, ")"),
    facet_label   = paste0(player_name, " · ", position),
    player_label  = fct_reorder(player_label,  total_sfb16_fpts),
    facet_label   = fct_reorder(facet_label,   total_sfb16_fpts, .desc = TRUE)
  )

week_cols <- paste0("week_", 1:18)

top50_long <- top50 |>
  select(player_label, facet_label, position, total_sfb16_fpts, any_of(week_cols)) |>
  pivot_longer(any_of(week_cols), names_to = "week", values_to = "fpts") |>
  mutate(week = as.integer(str_remove(week, "week_")))

per_game_avg <- top50_long |>
  group_by(facet_label) |>
  summarize(mean_fpts = mean(fpts, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
```

## Season Total Distributions

### Position Comparison

```{r}
#| label: fig-violin
#| fig-height: 5
#| fig-cap: "Violin widths reflect point density; boxes show IQR and median; dots are individual players."

pos_levels <- c("QB", "RB", "WR", "TE")
pos_idx    <- setNames(seq_along(pos_levels), pos_levels)
set.seed(42)
dat <- season |>
  filter(position_rank <= 50) |>
  mutate(
    pos_num    = pos_idx[as.character(position)],
    pos_jitter = pos_num + runif(n(), -0.12, 0.12)
  )

p <- plot_ly(showlegend = FALSE)
for (pos in pos_levels) {
  d <- filter(dat, as.character(position) == pos)
  p <- add_trace(p, data = d,
    x = ~pos_num, y = ~total_sfb16_fpts,
    type = "violin", name = pos,
    fillcolor = pos_colors[[pos]], opacity = 0.8,
    line     = list(color = "transparent"),
    box      = list(visible = TRUE,
                    line = list(color = "black", width = 1)),
    meanline = list(visible = FALSE),
    points   = FALSE, showlegend = FALSE
  )
}
p |>
  add_markers(
    data = dat, x = ~pos_jitter, y = ~total_sfb16_fpts,
    color = ~position, colors = pos_colors,
    text          = ~player_name,
    hovertemplate = "%{text}<extra></extra>",
    marker        = list(opacity = 0.8, size = 4),
    showlegend    = FALSE
  ) |>
  layout(
    title = list(text = "<b>Season SFB16 Points by Position</b><br><sup>Players with ≥ 8 games played & ≥ 50 points</sup>"),
    xaxis = list(tickmode = "array", tickvals = seq_along(pos_levels),
                 ticktext = pos_levels, title = ""),
    yaxis = list(title = "Season SFB16 Points", tickformat = ",d"),
    showlegend = FALSE
  )
```

### Top 50 Players

```{r}
#| label: fig-top50
#| fig-height: 9

season |>
  slice_max(total_sfb16_fpts, n = 50) |>
  mutate(label = paste0(player_name, " (", team, ")") |> fct_reorder(total_sfb16_fpts)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = total_sfb16_fpts, y = label, fill = position)) +
  geom_col(alpha = 0.85, width = 0.75) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = comma(round(total_sfb16_fpts, 1))),
    hjust = -0.08, size = 3.5, color = "grey20"
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = pos_colors) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.14)),
    labels = label_comma()
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Top 50 Players — SFB16 Season Totals",
    x = "Season SFB16 Points", y = NULL, fill = NULL
  ) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "top"
  )
```

### Consistency: Weekly Top-20 Finishes (Overall Top 50)

```{r}
#| label: fig-topN-counts
#| fig-height: 9
#| fig-cap: "Overall = top 20 among all players that week. Position = top 10 at their position that week."

season |>
  slice_max(total_sfb16_fpts, n = 50) |>
  mutate(label = paste0(player_name, " (", team, ")") |> fct_reorder(top20_overall_weeks)) |>
  pivot_longer(
    c(top20_overall_weeks, top10_pos_weeks),
    names_to = "type", values_to = "count"
  ) |>
  mutate(type = recode(type,
    top20_overall_weeks = "Overall Top 10",
    top10_pos_weeks     = "Position Top 10"
  )) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = count, y = label, fill = type)) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge", alpha = 0.85, width = 0.7) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Overall Top 20" = "#2c7bb6", "Position Top 10" = "#abd9e9")) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 0:18) +
  labs(
    title = "Weekly Top-20 Finish Counts — Top 50 Players",
    subtitle = "Overall (all positions) vs. within position · max 18 weeks",
    x = "Weeks in Overall Top 20 / Position Top 10", y = NULL, fill = NULL
  ) +
  theme(panel.grid.major.y = element_blank())
```

### Consistency: Weekly Top-20 Finishes (Top 50 @ each position)

```{r}
#| label: fig-topN-counts2
#| fig-height: 18

season |>

  mutate(label = paste0(player_name, " (", team, ")") |> fct_reorder(top20_overall_weeks)) |>
  pivot_longer(
    c(top20_overall_weeks, top10_pos_weeks),
    names_to = "type", values_to = "count"
  ) |>
  mutate(type = recode(type,
    top20_overall_weeks = "Overall Top 10",
    top10_pos_weeks     = "Position Top 10"
  )) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = count, y = label, fill = type)) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge", alpha = 0.85, width = 0.7) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Overall Top 20" = "#2c7bb6", "Position Top 10" = "#abd9e9")) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 0:18) +
  labs(
    title = "Weekly Top-20 Finish Counts — Top 50 Players",
    subtitle = "Overall (all positions) vs. within position · max 18 weeks",
    x = "Weeks in Overall Top 20 / Position Top 10", y = NULL, fill = NULL
  ) +
  theme(panel.grid.major.y = element_blank())
```

## Top 50 Players — Weekly Score Breakdown

### Weekly Score Distributions

```{r}
#| label: fig-weekly-box
#| fig-height: 10
#| fig-cap: "Box spans IQR; line = median. Dots are individual weekly scores. Ordered by season total."

top50_long |>
  ggplot(aes(x = fpts, y = player_label, fill = position, color = position)) +
  geom_boxplot(
    outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.3, width = 0.55,
    linewidth = 0.7
  ) +
  geom_point(
    data = top50_long |> filter(!is.na(fpts)),
    position = position_jitter(height = 0.18, seed = 42),
    alpha = 0.65, size = 2.2
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = pos_colors) +
  scale_color_manual(values = pos_colors) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = label_comma()) +
  labs(
    title    = "Weekly Score Distributions — Top 50 Players",
    subtitle = "Box = IQR · Dots = individual weekly scores · ordered by season total",
    x = "Weekly SFB16 Points", y = NULL,
    fill = NULL, color = NULL
  ) +
  theme(panel.grid.major.y = element_blank())
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-weekly-box2
#| fig-height: 14
#| fig-cap: "Box spans IQR; line = median. Dots are individual weekly scores. Ordered by season total."

top50_long |>
  ggplot(aes(x = fpts, y = player_label, fill = position, color = position)) +
  facet_wrap(~ position, scales = "free") +
  geom_boxplot(
    outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.3, width = 0.55,
    linewidth = 0.7
  ) +
  geom_point(
    data = top50_long |> filter(!is.na(fpts)),
    position = position_jitter(height = 0.18, seed = 42),
    alpha = 0.65, size = 2.2
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = pos_colors) +
  scale_color_manual(values = pos_colors) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = label_comma()) +
  labs(
    title    = "Weekly Score Distributions — Top 50 Players",
    subtitle = "Box = IQR · Dots = individual weekly scores · ordered by season total",
    x = "Weekly SFB16 Points", y = NULL,
    fill = NULL, color = NULL
  ) +
  theme(panel.grid.major.y = element_blank())
```

## PPR-SFB16 Comparison

### P

```{r}
#| label: fig-total-sfb-vs-ppr
#| fig-height: 14
#| fig-cap: "Box spans IQR; line = median. Dots are individual weekly scores. Ordered by season total."

season |>
  filter(position_rank <= 50) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = total_ppr_fpts, y = total_sfb16_fpts, fill = position, color = position)) +
  geom_point(
    alpha = 0.65, size = 2.2
  ) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm") +
  facet_wrap(~ position, scales = "free") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = pos_colors) +
  scale_color_manual(values = pos_colors) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = label_comma()) +
  labs(
    title    = "Weekly Score Distributions — Top 50 Players",
    subtitle = "Box = IQR · Dots = individual weekly scores · ordered by season total",
    x = "Weekly SFB16 Points", y = NULL,
    fill = NULL, color = NULL
  ) +
  theme(panel.grid.major.y = element_blank())
```
